The racing organization announced his passing on Thursday, expressing condolences to his family and the motorsports community. **Busch** had been hospitalized with a severe illness earlier in the day, and was unable to compete in this weekend's race in Charlotte, North Carolina. He won championships in 2015 and 2019 and is survived by his wife Samantha and children Brexton and Lennix.

recent_articles.title: Ladakh seeks belonging through representation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Ministry of Home Affairs** argues that Ladakh needs more districts rather than a legislature due to its sparse population, strategic sensitivity, and financial dependence on the Centre. This argument is criticized as flawed and reflects an impoverished understanding of democracy, echoing historical paternalistic views by the British Empire.

recent_articles.title: British radio Caroline apologises for accidental King Charles III death broadcast | World News - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Radio Caroline**, a historic British radio station, apologized after mistakenly broadcasting that **King Charles III** had died due to a computer error. The incident occurred on Tuesday afternoon and led to the station briefly going off air before resuming normal programming with an apology.  The station's manager, Peter Moore, explained that an internal "Death of a Monarch" procedure was accidentally triggered.
